snippet.title: Hytale - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You can now pre-purchase Hytale and reserve your username!
https://hytale.com 
Early Access launches January 13, 2026

Set out on an adventure built for both creation and play. Hytale blends the freedom of a sandbox with the momentum of an RPG: explore a procedurally generated world full of dungeons, secrets, and a variety of creatures, then shape it block by block.

Keep yourself updated by following us;
Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/hytale
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hytalegame/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/hytale.bsky.social
YouTube: http://youtube.com/hytale
